HARDWIPE.Braindance.Console.StatusRecove: Character restoration pending. Use Restore characters to recover.
HARDWIPE.Braindance.Console.StatusIdle: Link idle. Ready when you are.
HARDWIPE.Braindance.Error.OnlyGM: Only a GM can control a braindance.
HARDWIPE.Braindance.Error.AlreadyActive: A memory is already active. Apply changes or disconnect first.
HARDWIPE.Braindance.Error.IncompletePair: Choose a player character and an NPC sheet for every pairing.
HARDWIPE.Braindance.Error.PairingsLocked: Disconnect and restore the characters before changing the sheet pairings.
HARDWIPE.Braindance.Error.UnknownMarker: That moment is no longer on the timeline.
HARDWIPE.Braindance.Error.SystemUnsuppor: Full NPC replacement needs the D&D5e system.
HARDWIPE.Braindance.Error.RecoveryPendin: Restore the previous memory's characters before entering another memory.
HARDWIPE.Braindance.Error.ChooseCharacte: Choose a world character sheet for each player character.
HARDWIPE.Braindance.Error.ChooseNpc: Choose a world NPC sheet for each memory form.
HARDWIPE.Braindance.Error.NestedTransfor: Restore existing transformations before using either sheet in a braindance.
HARDWIPE.Braindance.Error.DuplicateChara: Each player character can have only one NPC form in a memory.
HARDWIPE.Braindance.Error.NoPlayer: {name} must be assigned to, or owned by, a player.
HARDWIPE.Braindance.Error.PlayerTwice: {name} controls more than one selected character. Use one pairing per player.
HARDWIPE.Braindance.Error.FormIdLost: Foundry did not keep the recovery identifier for the memory form.
HARDWIPE.Braindance.Error.RecoveryMissin: The recovery record is unavailable. Keep the memory forms and restore the recovery journal before retrying.
HARDWIPE.Braindance.Error.OriginalMissin: An original character is unavailable. Restore that character before retrying.
HARDWIPE.Braindance.Error.FormChanged: A memory form's identity has changed; automatic restoration was stopped.
HARDWIPE.Braindance.Error.AssignedMissin: A player's original assigned character is unavailable.
HARDWIPE.Braindance.Error.FormInUse: A token or player still uses a memory form. Retry restoration.
HARDWIPE.Turn.Title: Turn
HARDWIPE.Turn.StateHint: Click to mark the {slot} spent or ready. It comes back when your turn starts.
HARDWIPE.Turn.StandbyHint: Not your turn. Comes back online when your turn starts.
HARDWIPE.Turn.NothingLeftBonus: No action or bonus action left for {move}.
HARDWIPE.Turn.ActionType.Label: Action type
HARDWIPE.Turn.ActionType.Hint: Attack action: one attack of the Attack action, so Extra Attack gives more, and it can be an opportunity attack. Action: it takes the whole action. Until you pick, weapon and unarmed attacks are Attack action and everything else is Action.
HARDWIPE.Turn.AskReaction.Title: Reaction?
HARDWIPE.Turn.AskReaction.Content: {actor} used {item} outside their turn. Was that their reaction?
HARDWIPE.Turn.Unstaged: Encounter staged · waiting for the GM to start it
HARDWIPE.Turn.Move.dash.Label: Dash
HARDWIPE.Turn.Move.disengage.Label: Disengage
HARDWIPE.Turn.Move.disengage.Hint: Your movement doesn't provoke opportunity attacks for the rest of the turn.
HARDWIPE.Turn.Move.dodge.Label: Dodge
HARDWIPE.Turn.Move.dodge.Hint: Until your next turn, attacks against you have disadvantage and you have advantage on Dexterity saves.
HARDWIPE.Turn.Move.hide.Label: Hide
HARDWIPE.Turn.Move.hide.Hint: Roll Stealth to slip out of sight while you're heavily obscured or behind cover.
HARDWIPE.Turn.Move.grapple.Label: Grapple
HARDWIPE.Turn.Move.grapple.Hint: Grab a creature: an Athletics check against its Athletics or Acrobatics, in place of one attack of your Attack action. Target it first to post a contest card.
HARDWIPE.Turn.Move.shove.Label: Shove
HARDWIPE.Turn.Move.shove.Hint: Push a creature 5 ft away or knock it prone: an Athletics check against its Athletics or Acrobatics, in place of one attack. Target it first to post a contest card.
HARDWIPE.Turn.Note.takenBonus: Taken as bonus action · click to take back
HARDWIPE.Turn.Waiting.Label: Waiting on you
HARDWIPE.Request.Label: Roll call
HARDWIPE.Request.ContestNeedsTwo: A contest needs exactly two participants: the challenger first, then the defender.
HARDWIPE.Request.KeyHint: GM: open the roll call composer for the selected tokens.
HARDWIPE.Request.Composer.Title: Roll call
HARDWIPE.Request.Composer.NoOne: No one yet. Select tokens, then Add selected.
HARDWIPE.Request.Composer.NoOneError: Add at least one character or NPC to the roll call.
HARDWIPE.Request.Composer.Kind.Label: Resolve as
HARDWIPE.Request.Composer.KindHint.each: Everyone rolls; each passes or fails on their own.
HARDWIPE.Request.Composer.KindHint.group: One result for the crew: it passes when at least half of them pass.
HARDWIPE.Request.Composer.KindHint.conte: Two rolls, higher total wins and a tie goes to the defender. The first in the list rolls the roll above; the second picks one of these.
HARDWIPE.Comms.Queue.Head: comms queue · {count} open
HARDWIPE.Comms.Queue.Unpin: Let it close on its timer
HARDWIPE.Comms.Queue.CloseAllConfirm: Close all {count} open rolls? Players stop seeing them. Results already rolled stay on their cards.
HARDWIPE.Comms.Queue.Empty: no open rolls · the table is clear
HARDWIPE.Comms.Queue.Legend: ● online · ○ offline · Roll appears for NPCs and offline players · pin keeps a roll call past its timer
HARDWIPE.Comms.Setting.Combat.Name: Roll calls close in combat
HARDWIPE.Comms.Setting.Combat.Hint: When an unanswered roll call or contest closes during combat. Saves on cards and concentration interrupts never close on a timer; they leave once resolved.
HARDWIPE.Comms.Setting.Combat.round: At the end of the round they were posted
HARDWIPE.Comms.Setting.Combat.turn: At the end of the turn they were posted
HARDWIPE.Comms.Setting.Idle.Name: Roll calls close out of combat
HARDWIPE.Comms.Setting.Idle.Hint: How long an unanswered roll call posted outside combat stays open.
HARDWIPE.Comms.Setting.Limit.Name: Waiting on you shows at most
HARDWIPE.Comms.Setting.Limit.Hint: How many rolls the Turn tab's netlink strip lists before folding the rest under more.
